basic_info.description: Welcome to The Hamilton, one of San Francisco's iconic Art Deco buildings. This freshly updated studio shines with new carpet, fresh paint and a brand new stove- ready for you to move right in! Beyond your front door, The Hamilton offers a lifestyle thats hard to match: SOARING lobby ceilings, GLAMOROUS period light fixtures and VINTAGE details that transport you to another era. Enjoy TOP-NOTCH amenities including 24-HOUR front desk SECURITY, on-site management, a 16th-floor VIEW DECK with sweeping city vistas, a fitness room, and a grand ballroom with kitchen and courtyard fountain for UNFORGETTABLE gatherings. Why settle for ordinary when you can own a pice of San Francisco history- blending character, convenience, and community all in one.
